linguistics_rules.how: 先按句末标点[.!?…]与换行切句;再按并列/转折连词{but,however,though,although,while,whereas,但,不过,只是}切子句。转折词后子句极性权重更高,confidence+0.05。每子句独立配对一组aspect-opinion实现一评论多四元组。

否定触发词{not,no,never,none,hardly,barely,without,doesn't,don't,didn't,isn't,wasn't,can't,won't,不,没,无,别}。作用域从否定词向右到下一标点/转折连词/because,最多跨5 token。域内opinion施加neg_factor=-0.8翻转。双重否定相互抵消不翻转。'not only...but also'视强调不翻转。

紧邻(左1-2 token)修饰opinion时施intensifier_factor: extremely/absolutely=1.6,very/really/so=1.3,quite/pretty=1.15,基准=1.0,slightly/a bit/somewhat=0.6,barely=0.5。'too'+形容词恒为该方面neg(factor=1.2且base强制取负)。感叹号+0.05幅度,全大写词×1.1。
同一子句内每个opinion配对token绝对距离最近的候选aspect(须seed/canonical命中)。无显式aspect有opinion→隐式方面:opinion反查类目提示词典推断aspect_category,aspect_is_implicit=true。一aspect配多opinion时取|分值|最大作主,其余并列输出。
aspect_term小写化、去复数去限定词后查同义词→canonical→aspect_category。命中canonical直接得类目;未命中退seed子串匹配;仍未命中且有观点词→标UNMAPPED交LLM mediator(-0.15 confidence)。
polarity_score=clip(base_polarity(opinion)×neg_factor×intensifier_factor×irony_factor,-1,1)。base来自极性词典(极端0.9/强0.7/中0.5/弱0.3),未命中base=0=neu。离散polarity由±0.15阈值切分。

linguistics_rules.rule: 简单反讽(高精度低召回)
linguistics_rules.how: 仅确定模式:(1)正向词+负面场景短语('great if you enjoy [负面]','perfect for [不想要场景]','love how it [负面动词]');(2)star<=2但规则分>0.3的星-文冲突→is_ironic疑似,irony_factor=-1翻转并-0.15 confidence交LLM复核;(3)引号包裹正向词+'yeah right/not'。命中即is_ironic=true并翻转polarity_score。剩余反讽/比较级隐含贬义交LLM。

linguistics_rules.rule: 隐式方面/观点缺失兜底
linguistics_rules.how: 子句既无aspect又无opinion→丢弃不产四元组(避免噪声挂FUNCTIONALITY)。仅有整体情感词无方面→记aspect_category=OVERALL(不进12类rollup,仅供sentiment_12w趋势)。
aspect_category经scope_rules表校验(BATTERY仅electronics,SMELL_NOISE仅home/appliance/furniture/outdoor)。品类不符则aspect_category_scope_ok=false且confidence-0.20,防误挂。

factors.formula: High(sp_api/keepa)=1.0; Medium(dataforseo/brightdata/oxylabs/卖家精灵)=0.85; Low(helium/apify/无verified/被降级)=0(不进定量)
0.5^(age_days/540); 地板clamp下限0.25 (rollup变体用半衰期180天:0.5^(age_days/180))
Π(各命中刷单信号的降权因子, 未命中=1.0)

clip(0.30*f_extract + 0.25*f_pair + 0.20*f_lex + 0.25*f_src - penalties, 0, 1); f_extract=显式双1.0/一显一隐0.6/双隐0.3; f_pair=1/(1+token_dist/5),跨子句0.4; f_lex=|base_polarity|,未命中0.2; f_src=High1.0/Med0.7/Low0.4; penalties=反讽-0.15+scope_false-0.20+UNMAPPED-0.15+否定跨标点-0.05+官方冲突-0.1

trust_weighting.composite_formula: evidence_weight = clip(w_source × w_verified × w_recency × w_length × w_helpful × w_consistency × w_spam, 0, 3.0)。前置闸:若source==Low或单条被反刷单降级或四元组confidence<0.35 → evidence_weight=0且不进定量rollup,只入定性池。加权rollup:avg_polarity=Σ(w·polarity_score)/Σw; neg_ratio=Σ(w·I(neg))/Σw; mention_count用有效计数Σw。每条落review_weight_ledger供溯源HITL。

spam_signals.pattern: 同asin/品牌下body 3-gram shingle→MinHash签名,Jaccard≥0.8或SimHash汉明距离≤3;去数字/表情归一后完全相同
spam_signals.action: 整簇每条w_spam*=0.2;簇内保留最早1条为代表,其余is_duplicate=true排除定量rollup(仅留1票)

spam_signals.pattern: rating∈{1,5}且token_count<8且无aspect seed命中且无具体名词(全泛化词great/love/perfect/worst)
同asin滑窗≤3天评论数>历史日均5×(z-score:daily>mean+3*std)且簇内verified<0.5
spam_signals.action: 簇内每条w_spam*=0.4;打burst_flag;簇占该asin总评>30%触发HITL

spam_signals.pattern: 正则命中'received (this|a)? free'/'in exchange for (my|an)?(honest)? review'/'discount(ed)? in exchange'/'complimentary'/'sent to me (for free|to test)'/'vine'
spam_signals.action: free/exchange类w_spam*=0.15且confidence降Low(不进定量);vine_flag类w_spam*=0.6保留但标注

spam_signals.pattern: (有reviewer_id时)同组reviewer_id多无关asin高频共现或短期大量五星;MVP无id时降级为同asin正文风格指纹(标点/emoji/句长分布)聚类异常
spam_signals.action: w_spam*=0.25;farm_suspect=true进spam_ledger累积画像(嵌入聚类为LLM增强)

columns.name: mention_count
columns.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT review_id) 命中该aspect(同评论多句去重)

columns.name: mention_rate
columns.formula: mention_count / asin_total_reviews_in_window

columns.name: eff_mention
columns.formula: Σ evidence_weight(有效证据密度,替代裸计数)

columns.name: avg_polarity_weighted
columns.formula: Σ(polarity_score_i·w_i)/Σw_i, w_i=evidence_weight

columns.name: neg_ratio_weighted
columns.formula: Σ(w_i·I(polarity=neg))/Σw_i

columns.name: pos_ratio_weighted
columns.formula: Σ(w_i·I(polarity=pos))/Σw_i

columns.name: neu_ratio_weighted
columns.formula: 1 - neg_ratio_weighted - pos_ratio_weighted

columns.name: polarity_dispersion
columns.formula: sqrt(Σ w_i·(polarity_score_i - avg_polarity_weighted)^2 / Σw_i);高=两极分化(批次差异)

columns.name: verified_share
columns.formula: Σ(w_i·I(verified))/Σw_i

columns.name: return_risk_rate
columns.formula: Σ(w_i·I(signals_return_risk))/Σw_i

gold_tables.why: 所有下游表的加权事实底座;加权版抗水军/无验证/陈旧噪声,直接改变'哪个方面在拖后腿'的选品判断

columns.name: importance_score
columns.formula: 归一化: z(mention_rate_across_asins)·0.5 + z(|corr(aspect_neg, review_rating)|)·0.5;方面被谈越普及且与总评相关越强=越重要

columns.name: rating_elasticity
columns.formula: β from OLS: review_rating ~ Σ aspect_neg_flags;单位aspect负面对星级的边际影响

columns.name: is_hygiene_or_delighter
columns.formula: neg侧elasticity高且pos侧低→hygiene(必须做对);pos侧高→delighter(卖点);供Kano联表

gold_tables.why: 决定改良/卖点资源投向权重最大的方面,防止把低影响cosmetic当核心痛点

columns.name: pain_frequency
columns.formula: Σ evidence_weight where neg,按category跨asin聚合

columns.name: severity_weight
columns.formula: Σ(evidence_weight·severity_score),severity_score:deal_breaker=1.0/major=0.7/minor=0.3/cosmetic=0.1

columns.name: unmet_supply_gap
columns.formula: 1 - (satisfied_asin_count / total_asin_count),该痛点被市场解决的稀缺度

columns.name: opportunity_score
columns.formula: (pain_frequency_norm·0.4 + severity_weight_norm·0.35 + unmet_supply_gap·0.25)·importance_score

columns.name: rank
columns.formula: DENSE_RANK按opportunity_score DESC分category

gold_tables.why: 直接输出'先攻哪个痛点/白空间'的选品优先级排序,融合频次×严重度×供给稀缺×方面重要度

columns.name: pos_mention_share
columns.formula: Σ(w·I(aspect,pos))/Σ(w over asin)

columns.name: neg_mention_share
columns.formula: Σ(w·I(aspect,neg))/Σ(w over asin)

columns.name: kano_class
columns.formula: neg高&pos低→must-be(基础必备);neg高&pos高→one-dimensional(线性满意);neg低&pos高→attractive(兴奋型/差异化);两低→indifferent

columns.name: satisfaction_coef
columns.formula: pos_share/(pos_share+neg_share)

columns.name: dissatisfaction_coef
columns.formula: neg_share/(pos_share+neg_share)

gold_tables.why: 区分must-be(做错就死)vs attractive(做对惊喜)=产品定义与差异化卖点分层,避免在indifferent方面浪费

columns.name: cell_mention
columns.formula: Σ evidence_weight where(jtbd_scenario命中 AND aspect命中)

columns.name: cell_neg_ratio
columns.formula: Σ(w·I(neg))/Σw within cell

columns.name: scenario_aspect_lift
columns.formula: cell_neg_ratio / overall_aspect_neg_ratio;>1=该方面在该场景下痛点被放大

columns.name: whitespace_flag
columns.formula: 高scenario频次 AND 高cell_neg_ratio AND 低满足asin数→变体化选品信号(如'露营加固版')

gold_tables.why: 把泛品类拆成用途×方面的可攻细分,直接指导变体选品与场景化listing关键词

columns.name: neg_ratio_weighted_m
columns.formula: 月度加权neg_ratio(recency半衰期180天)

columns.name: mention_share_m
columns.formula: 月度该方面eff_mention/asin月度总eff_mention

columns.name: trend_slope
columns.formula: OLS斜率over最近6个月neg_ratio_weighted_m;>0=恶化(新批次质量下滑预警)

columns.name: change_point_flag
columns.formula: CUSUM/相邻月Δ>2σ标记突变点,对应供应链/批次切换

gold_tables.why: 捕捉'现在这个品的问题'随批次漂移,恶化趋势=避坑信号,改善趋势=时机信号

columns.name: my_avg_polarity_w
columns.formula: 本品加权avg_polarity(经SP-API锚校准a,b修正)

columns.name: comp_avg_polarity_w
columns.formula: 竞品集加权avg_polarity(应用同品类coverage_bias与(a,b)先验平移)

columns.name: gap
columns.formula: my_avg_polarity_w - comp_avg_polarity_w;负=本品在该方面落后

columns.name: switch_reason_share
columns.formula: Σ(w·I(competitor_switch∈{switched_from,worse_than_alt}))命中该aspect/竞品提及总数;竞品离开原因=你的卖点

columns.name: defensible_moat_flag
columns.formula: gap>0且comp neg高且my pos高→护城河卖点;gap<0且importance高→紧急追赶项

gold_tables.why: 逐方面竞品相对竞争力+转换叙事,直接喂差异化定位与'比竞品更X'卖点证据链

deterministic_now: 分句/子句切分(标点+转折连词)
否定触发词+5-token作用域检测与neg_factor翻转、双重否定抵消
程度副词intensifier_factor缩放、'too'+形容词强制负、感叹号/全大写修饰
方面词三级归一(小写化/去复数→同义词→canonical→aspect_category)
seed子串命中的aspect_category分类与UNMAPPED标记
四元组就近配对(token距离最短启发式)
确定性反讽3模式(正向词+负面场景、星文冲突star<=2且分>0.3、引号+yeah right)
DEFECT_MODE部件+失效动词正则(纯规则)
反刷单:MinHash近重复、extreme_star_no_detail、burst z-score时间簇、incentivized_disclosure正则、无reviewer_id时的风格指纹
evidence_weight合成、Low/quarantine前置闸、定量vs定性池分流
全部7张gold表的加权rollup/统计/OLS斜率/CUSUM/DENSE_RANK/Kano象限判定
SP-API锚校准的线性(a,b)最小二乘修正基线与MAE监控
llm_enhanced_later: aspect-mediator整句一次性输出ACOS四元组数组(取代seed命中,解决隐式方面/长距离配对/UNMAPPED/跨品类零样本)
LLM回归连续polarity_score并用SP-API官方情感做锚校准base
反讽/比较级隐含贬义/条件式抱怨兜底(规则外剩余部分)
UNMET_NEED的slot_filling(具体缺什么功能/变体/配件归一化)
SEVERITY/EMOTION混合意图与语境化判定
SP-API topic→aspect_category语义映射与校准残差诊断
反刷单reviewer_farm的嵌入聚类账号农场画像
BERT-ABSA作为LLM与纯规则之间的中间判别式档位(可插拔extractor,幂等键回填A/B)

differentiation_note: 六维度经对抗检查确保正交不重叠:ABSA四元组=方面级情感事实(what+how positive);REVIEW_INTENT=沟通功能(为什么写这条,路由管道);JTBD=使用场景(在哪用);PERSONA=谁在用;DEFECT_MODE=QUALITY/DURABILITY负面的部件级细化(不与aspect_category重叠,是其下钻);UNMET_NEED=愿望/白空间(正向缺口,非既有方面评价);COMPETITOR=相对参照系;SEVERITY=阻断严重度(决策权重,与polarity正交:强负≠致命);EMOTION=情感能量(排序权重,与polarity正交:neg可以是frustration或regret)。每标签均改变具体选品动作:DEFECT_MODE→QC清单;UNMET_NEED→变体定义;SEVERITY→改良投入优先级;COMPETITOR→差异化卖点;JTBD×aspect→场景变体。每张gold表落一个决策:rollup=事实底座、importance=资源投向、opportunity_rank=先攻谁、Kano=must-be/delighter分层、usecase_matrix=变体化、trend=避坑时机、competitor_gap=定位。确定性部分全部可离线纯Python编码(正则/词典/MinHash/OLS/CUSUM/加权聚合),LLM仅在契约不变前提下热替换抽取/实体/语义映射/聚类四类增强点,规则分永远作为离线基线与降级fallback。
